metadata.content:
Current task: Fix save → preview sync without breaking stable branch
Scope locked:


ONLY touch save trigger + preview refresh


NO rewrites


NO runtime/preview route changes



Step 1 — Locate save handler
Find where file write happens:
Likely one of:


handleSave


/api/dev/files/write


editor save callback


You are NOT changing logic — only adding sync trigger.

Step 2 — Add controlled refresh trigger
Inside your builder component:
Add state (top of component)
TypeScriptconst [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

Step 3 — Hook into save (critical)
Find your save function and modify ONLY this part:
TypeScriptconst handleSave = async () => {
  await saveFile(); // your existing logic

  setRefreshKey(prev => prev + 1);
};
Rules:


MUST be after await


MUST NOT trigger before write completes



Step 4 — Wire preview to refreshKey
Find your preview iframe.
Replace ONLY the src:
TypeScript<iframe
  src={`/api/dev/preview?projectId=${projectId}&v=${refreshKey}`}
/>
Do NOT touch anything else.

Step 5 — Remove unstable reloads (if present)
If you see:
TypeScriptDate.now()
setInterval
random state triggers
Remove them.
You want:

→ ONE trigger = save

Step 6 — Test (strict)
Run this exact sequence:


Open app/page.tsx


Change text → Save


Preview updates


Repeat 5–10 times



Expected behavior


No manual refresh


No blank preview


No delay


No stale content



If it fails
Tell me EXACT symptom:


“save works but preview not updating”


“preview reloads but old content”


“blank after save”


Each one has a different root cause.

Do NOT do next


Do NOT touch preview route


Do NOT refactor builder


Do NOT integrate diff yet



Completion condition
You confirm:
→ save → instant preview update (stable)
Then we move to:

→ diff → apply → same pipeline integration
